f5.value: Hours Monday to Thursday 8.00am to 5.00pm, Friday 8.00am to 4.00pm

f6.value: The suites are within the Buderim Private Hospital precinct with on-site parking. Take the Blue Lifts to our floor. Our rooms include a dedicated procedure room for in-clinic treatment under local anaesthetic or IV sedation, and on-site 3D CBCT imaging.

f2.value: Because both surgeons are dual-qualified specialists operating in accredited hospitals, patients travel to us from well beyond the Sunshine Coast. We regularly treat patients from Gympie, Hervey Bay, Maryborough, Bundaberg, Caboolture and the Moreton Bay region, and accept referrals from dentists and doctors in Brisbane and regional Queensland for complex implant, grafting, jaw and trauma cases.

f3.value: Not sure which location suits you?

f4.value: Call us and our patient coordinator will match you with the closest consulting location and hospital for your procedure.
